gates.label: Clinical and programme approval
gates.detail: Named clinical owners, approved programme content and deployment-specific safety evidence required.

gates.label: Two live programme destinations
gates.detail: Actual credentials, grants, signed callbacks and independent partner receipts are pending. Dispatch remains worker-triggered.

gates.label: Live EHR acceptance
gates.detail: Selected EHR testing, identity matching and clinical ingestion evidence are pending.

gates.label: ABDM exchange and conformance
gates.detail: ABHA linking and HIU consent artefacts exist against a local mock gateway only. HIP publication, encrypted transfer, sandbox onboarding and official profile validation remain outstanding.

gates.label: Approved live AI
gates.detail: Credential activation and intended-use, accuracy and language validation are pending.

gates.label: Disconnected field and speech testing
gates.detail: HTTPS physical-device restart, disconnected sync and on-device language validation are pending.

gates.label: Independent security and accessibility assessment
gates.detail: Independent penetration review, screen-reader and physical-device accessibility evidence are pending.

gates.label: Hosted disaster recovery and scale
gates.detail: Local encrypted restore drill and bounded local load checks do not establish hosted RPO/RTO or deployment capacity.

budgets.notice: Estimated from recorded cost assumptions and recorded or reserved token use; not an invoice or provider bill. Agent requests only; evaluations, hosting and other charges are excluded.

invoices.notice: Saha figures are estimates from recorded token use and the current cost assumptions (a sent request without recorded usage counts at the reserved allowance). The invoice figures are what an owner recorded from the provider. Agent requests only; evaluations, hosting and other charges are excluded. Reconciling never changes budgets or cost assumptions.
